title: Low-Cal Spicy Thai Noodle Salad
subtitle: with Mushroom, Tomato and Cashews
description: Dinner is guilt-free with this healthy salad. Top rice noodles with Thai-spiced mushrooms, pickled onion and tomato. It's a delicious way to eat a rainbow!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the eggs. Thinly slice the onion. Thickly slice the mushrooms. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems. Coarsely chop the cashews. Halve the tomato and thinly slice. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves.

Pickle onion: Cook 2 eggs in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins for soft-boiled, or 8 mins for hard-boiled. Drain, then cool in cold water. Meanwhile, put 1 tbs red wine vinegar, ¼ tsp salt and 1 tsp honey in a bowl and stir until the honey dissolves. Add the onion and toss to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Cook mushrooms: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Heat 3 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook, stirring, for 5-6 mins until browned. Add the coriander stems, garlic, Thai seasoning and 1 tsp vegetable oil and cook for 2-3 mins until fragrant. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.

Cook noodles: Meanwhile, cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 7 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under cold water to prevent the noodles from sticking (see Make it yours). Peel and halve the eggs. Drain the onion, reserving the pickling liquid. Add 1 tbs soy sauce to the pickling liquid and stir to combine.
Serve up: Divide the noodles among bowls and top with the mushroom mixture, tomato, pickled onion and egg. Scatter over the cashews and coriander leaves, drizzle with the soy dressing and enjoy!
Make it yours: Cut the noodles into shorter, more manageable lengths with scissors, if desired.
